Excitebike 64.name: Excitebike 64
Excitebike 64.summary: Experience extreme MX! You grind your way through the hairpin turn, a wall of mud exploding in your wake. Your next jump launches you into the air - you pull off a spectacular double no-footed can-can and become an instant legend! In Excitebike 64, you'll find all the high-flying action, heart-stopping stunts and bone-jarring crashes of the extreme sport of motocross. It'll set the daredevil inside you free. 20 stadium tracks and awesome outdoor courses - plus six different riders with six unique styles!

Sonic Wings Assault.name: AeroFighters Assault
Sonic Wings Assault.summary: The Aero Fighters Assault team needs your help to save the Earth from the evil Phutta Morgana organization and their machines of doom. Join the battle and choose your fighter from 6 different aircrafts with unique missiles and special weapons to wipe out your enemies in 3D-environment!
